bootstrap.method: percentile; days resampled with replacement; token-weighted mean

classification_rule: metrics computed per seed then averaged; macro-F1 uses observed true/predicted label union
decomposition_rule: mapped vocabulary; all-target contribution, not switch-only conditional mean
better_single_note: A/B selected by aggregate held-out LL for descriptive M2 comparison; CI conditions on that selection

configuration.report_note: Inventory O: guy_coda_type with Sharma-flagged ornamented codas relabelled to their neighbour's type (PLAN [P7], DEC-31). Only the labels differ from RQ1: targets, folds, S, the UNK policy, the model and its selection rule are RQ1's. The log-likelihoods, accuracies and macro-F1 values in this report are not comparable with any other inventory's; the comparison with inventory A is reports/rq1_ornament_merge.md. With skip_nonconverged_candidates on, an L2 candidate that fails the convergence check is left out of the validation-day selection and counted below.
